Support for following patterns:

  • one or more repetitions ‐ +

  • last single match ‐ $
  • (one|two|three) ‐ group
  • [start-end] ‐ range

Support for following special groups:

  • word ‐ \w
  • not word ‐ \W
  • digit ‐ \d

  • white space ‐ \s

System.ML.AdaBoost.description: Discrete AdaBoost over single-feature boolean decision stumps. Each round picks the stump (feature + polarity) with the lowest weighted error, gives it a vote of alpha = 0.5*ln((1-err)/err) and re-weights the samples to focus on mistakes; prediction is the sign of the weighted stump vote. Deterministic. Boosting stops early when no stump beats chance.
